findings.text: The lane exposes a family of interrupt flow handlers for simple level edge fast end of interrupt fast end of interrupt non maskable per CPU per CPU device identifier and untracked delivery. Each accepts a descriptor and performs the acknowledge mask dispatch statistics and end of interrupt steps suited to its trigger model.

Central dispatch clears pending indication marks hardware in progress invokes the per CPU handler chain records entropy and runs spurious accounting unless debug suppression is set. The outer stage releases and reacquires serialization around per CPU invocation while the inner stage walks the action chain and combines outcomes.

Post dispatch accounting ignores descriptors flagged polled or poll in progress validates the combined outcome encoding reports bogus values with throttling applies threaded deferral rules and otherwise updates unhandled and total tallies with misroute adjustment. Persistently unhandled lines progress toward diagnostic reporting and disablement.

Unhandled tally handling resets the unhandled count when the last unhandled timestamp is older than a short window and otherwise increments it. Total events accumulate until a large evaluation period is reached then reset with the unhandled share examined. An extreme unhandled share triggers stuck reporting software and hardware disablement with depth growth and arming of a periodic poll timer.

Threaded outcomes that only request wakeup defer evaluation by one hardware event using a marker bit in the stored last handled snapshot. The following event compares the live threaded handled count with the snapshot to reclassify the prior event as handled or unhandled and preserves the marker for the current event. Mixed handled plus wakeup outcomes clear the marker without consulting thread counts.

Edge delivery records pending with mask and acknowledge when generic handling is refused and otherwise acknowledges once then loops dispatch while pending persists and the line remains enabled. Inside the loop missing actions cause masking and exit while a raced arrival triggers re enable when allowed. Each iteration dispatches through the central event path.

Fast end of interrupt delivery on power management refusal records pending when resend is needed and conditionally issues end of interrupt. When actions cannot run it masks then conditionally issues end of interrupt. Otherwise it accounts statistics masks oneshot lines dispatches centrally then conditionally unmasks with end of interrupt and resends when pending survived.

Poll based recovery only considers descriptors that are neither per CPU nor nested thread nor explicitly polled that remain enabled unless forced polling is requested that possess an action chain whose first entry is shared and not timer marked and that are not already in progress. Busy descriptors are instead flagged pending for later handling.

Action chain execution combines each handler outcome into an aggregate by inclusive combination wakes a thread when wakeup is requested and a thread routine exists warns once when wakeup is requested without a routine and records threaded hard interrupt context only when the descriptor allows threading and the action lacks no thread per CPU and oneshot attributes. Interrupts are required disabled across each handler with a one time warning and forced disable on violation.

Misroute recovery is fully disabled under one fixup setting runs for unhandled outcomes when enabled and under a stronger setting also runs for handled outcomes on interrupt zero or on poll flagged actions with a lockless action snapshot. A global active counter permits only one concurrent scan across all descriptors and records the scanning CPU. Successful recovery reduces the unhandled tally for unhandled outcomes.

Outcomes exceeding the combination of handled and wakeup are classified bogus and reported through a throttled path limited to a fixed number of reports while stuck unhandled lines use an unthrottled path. Both paths log the interrupt number with a stack trace and enumerate primary handlers with their threaded companions while holding serialization with interrupt state saved.

Simple level edge and fast end of interrupt flows hold descriptor serialization across the whole flow except for a window inside central dispatch where serialization is released across per CPU handler execution and reacquired before clearing in progress. Untracked delivery instead uses two short serialized sections around unlocked per CPU execution with in progress bridging the gap.

Polling holds descriptor serialization while marking poll in progress and repeatedly invoking central dispatch until pending clears or the action chain disappears then clears the poll marker. Diagnostic reporting acquires descriptor serialization with interrupt state saved because accounting itself runs without the lock while progress is indicated.

Thread wakeup uses an exiting check plus test and set of run state to ensure a single wakeup per action and increments an active count observed by synchronizing waiters. The oneshot mask update relies on hard interrupt non reentrancy and ordering against thread completion through descriptor serialization and in progress state with wakeup safe before the thread reaches sleep because the run flag is observed first.

Observed descriptor state comprises accessor protected status serialization hardware data with number and chip action chain flow handler pointer name depth interrupt state flags oneshot mask active count handled count with last snapshot unhandled and total counts with last unhandled time and per CPU enable mask. Observed action state comprises flags primary and thread routines device identifiers with per CPU variant and affinity thread control block with flags and mask linkage and name.

Judging a line stuck disables it in software and hardware and shifts it to timer driven polling which alters latency and may mask persistent hardware faults. Per CPU non maskable and untracked paths avoid shared serialization and shared counters so correctness depends on no cross CPU serialization need single action assumptions and tolerance of concurrent per CPU arrivals.

Concurrent misroute scans are serialized by a global active count with nested attempts immediately reporting no success and decrementing on exit. Thread wakeup hazards include lost wakeup before thread sleep use after thread exit and repeated wakeup which are addressed by run flag test and set exiting checks active counting and once only warning for missing thread routines.

Outcome encoding uses none handled and wake thread values with chain combination by inclusive combination and validity defined as not exceeding handled combined with wake thread. Selection depends on shared timer poll no thread per CPU and oneshot action attributes polled per CPU and threadable descriptor settings and pending poll in progress spurious disabled and oneshot descriptor states with disabled masked and in progress hardware states.

Timing and threshold facts are a short unhandled reset window of one tenth of a second an evaluation period of one hundred thousand events a stuck threshold of ninety nine thousand nine hundred unhandled events a deferred evaluation marker in bit thirty one of the last handled snapshot and a configured spurious poll timer interval.

Null handler installation selects the bad handler path while real installation walks hierarchical hardware data refusing chained bringup when outer hardware is absent. Uninstall masks with acknowledge marks disabled clears chained linkage with power release and sets depth to one. Chained installation reapplies trigger type when set marks no probe no request and no thread attaches a shared chained action acquires power and activates with resend followed by validity update.

Per CPU handling without device identifier acknowledges dispatches per CPU stages with randomness and issues end of interrupt without touching shared totals. Device identifier variant selects the first action whose affinity contains the current CPU and passes its per CPU identifier otherwise disables the CPU when enabled and logs once. Untracked handling clears pending marks in progress dispatches without statistics or spurious accounting then clears in progress.

When static duration checking is enabled each primary handler execution is timed with a processor clock and over threshold durations are logged with CPU number handler identity and microsecond duration. Tracing surrounds each handler entry and exit and long duration checks only occur on the enabled path.

Level delivery masks with acknowledge on entry then after central dispatch re enables only when the line remains enabled stays masked and has no oneshot thread activity. End of interrupt variant additionally issues end of interrupt immediately for non oneshot lines and for oneshot lines either combines end of interrupt with re enable when idle or issues end of interrupt alone when threaded completion is pending unless the chip requests threaded end of interrupt.

Simple delivery checks power management gating with pending recording when resend is needed and checks action gating before accounting and dispatch. Level and simple paths share the same central dispatch and statistics accounting while differing in mask and acknowledge handling.
